title: A vision-language foundation model for the generation of realistic chest X-ray images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A vision-language foundation model for the generation of realistic chest X-ray images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The paucity of high-quality medical imaging datasets could be mitigated by machine learning models that generate compositionally diverse images that faithfully represent medical concepts and pathologies.

evidence.text: The paucity of high-quality medical imaging datasets could be mitigated by machine learning models that generate compositionally diverse images that faithfully represent medical concepts and pathologies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A vision-language foundation model for the generation of realistic chest X-ray images》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】However, large vision-language models are trained on natural images, and the diversity distribution of the generated images substantially differs from that of medical images.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Specifically, by leveraging publicly available datasets of chest X-ray images and the corresponding radiology reports, we adapted a latent diffusion model pre-trained on pairs of natural images and text descriptors to generate diverse and visually plausible synthetic chest X-ray images (as confirmed by board-certified radiologists) whose appearance can be controlled with free-form medical text prompts.

evidence.text: However, large vision-language models are trained on natural images, and the diversity distribution of the generated images substantially differs from that of medical images.

Specifically, by leveraging publicly available datasets of chest X-ray images and the corresponding radiology reports, we adapted a latent diffusion model pre-trained on pairs of natural images and text descriptors to generate diverse and visually plausible synthetic chest X-ray images (as confirmed by board-certified radiologists) whose appearance can be controlled with free-form medical text prompts.
